fields.description: Derived from the Employee. The dispatch check is keyed on it.
fields.label: User

fields.description: Leave empty for open-ended. An open-ended restriction is reviewed, not forgotten -- the weekly digest lists it.
fields.label: Until

fields.description: Canceled with one l, house style.
fields.label: Status

fields.description: Tick what applies. This record says what somebody may NOT do and for how long -- it deliberately has nowhere to write WHY, because a restriction is a scheduling fact and a diagnosis is not the company's business.
fields.label: What they cannot do

fields.description: Nothing over the weight noted below.
fields.label: No lifting

fields.description: Not on company business, in any vehicle.
fields.label: No driving

fields.description: No ladder, no roof, no platform edge.
fields.label: No ladders or heights

fields.description: No vault, wet well or pump pit entry.
fields.label: No confined space

fields.description: No dosing, decanting or SDS-listed product.
fields.label: No chemical handling

fields.description: No basin, no pool, no standing water.
fields.label: No entering water

fields.description: Must be with somebody for the whole visit.
fields.label: No working alone

fields.description: The number on the note, if there is one.
fields.label: Lifting limit (lbs)

fields.description: Anything a supervisor needs in order to schedule around this. NOT the reason -- see above.
fields.label: Note

fields.description: The day the restriction stopped applying. Stamped when status moves to Ended. Without it a past-date question cannot be answered at all -- `status` is a fact about today, and marking a row Ended would erase the fact that it ever applied.
fields.label: Ended On

fields.description: The day the restriction was withdrawn as never having applied. Distinct from Ended, which means it ran its course.
fields.label: Canceled On

fields.description: Set by the backfill when a transition date could not be recovered, saying so plainly rather than inventing one.
fields.label: History Note
